method: Fixed rubric v1; implementation-agent judgments with execution evidence; no independent human ratings.

rounds.hypothesis: Removing remote font imports preserves the visit while eliminating required cross-origin requests.
rounds.change: Use the existing local/system fallback font stack, preserving train geometry and colors.
rounds.assessment: Privacy/offline dependency criterion improves only if the no-external-request browser test passes; visual quality is reviewed separately.

rounds.hypothesis: Treating storage as optional allows private-mode and denied-storage visits to boot and complete a rest action.
rounds.change: Centralize guarded browser preference reads and writes without changing persistence when storage is available.
rounds.assessment: The browser storage API is deliberately denied; the full scene, settings toggle, and seating must still work.

rounds.hypothesis: Parsing and bounding a persisted volume before use prevents NaN from leaking into UI and AudioParam values.
rounds.change: Use a finite 0..100 parser with a documented 45 percent default.
rounds.assessment: Verify corrupt storage, persisted values, and denied storage under the same frozen browser cases.

rounds.hypothesis: Listening for operating-system reduced-motion changes preserves comfort without overriding an explicit visitor choice.
rounds.change: Track the media query live and retain an in-memory explicit override even when storage is denied.
rounds.assessment: Runtime media emulation changes must update the checkbox; explicit and storage-denied settings remain usable.

rounds.hypothesis: A single action-menu close path keeps visual visibility, expanded semantics, and keyboard focus consistent.
rounds.change: Centralize closing, focus the opened menu, restore focus on Escape, and close on outside input.
rounds.assessment: Check the visible menu, expanded state, restored trigger focus, and unaffected rest journey.

rounds.hypothesis: Making modal siblings inert isolates keyboard and assistive navigation while preserving focus restoration.
rounds.change: Save and restore sibling inert states, harden visible-focusable selection, and avoid stale restoration when no modal is open.
rounds.assessment: The frozen modal case checks backward focus wrapping, background inert state, and restoration; settings and download still work.

rounds.hypothesis: A focusable scene with bounded arrow movement and deliberate cancellation makes the core visit usable without pointer aiming.
rounds.change: Label and focus the canvas; add arrow/Enter/Escape controls and reject late asynchronous seating after cancellation.
rounds.assessment: Exercise actual browser keyboard input, cancel movement, and retain menu and rest-journey regressions.

rounds.hypothesis: Explicit connection state and online/offline handling make solo fallback and recovery understandable and timely.
rounds.change: Show finding/together/solo states, react to browser connectivity, and ignore callbacks from superseded sockets.
rounds.assessment: Toggle the actual browser context offline and back; verify visible fallback, recovered connection, and reciprocal presence.

rounds.hypothesis: Serializing and catching audio startup keeps unavailable sound from breaking the quiet visit.
rounds.change: Guard concurrent toggles, clean up failed contexts, restore the control, and synchronize its accessible label.
rounds.assessment: Inject an unavailable AudioContext, require actionable feedback and zero unhandled page errors, and retain normal settings/rest journeys.

rounds.hypothesis: Handling renderer creation failure locally offers an actionable visit fallback without hiding unrelated application errors.
rounds.change: Isolate initialization so renderer failure can return normally; show a readable static fallback with deliberate retry.
rounds.assessment: Deny WebGL in a real browser context, require a visible explanation and retry, and preserve normal rendering and capture.

rounds.hypothesis: A lost graphics context must terminate scene-owned work and offer an intentional restart instead of leaving a frozen interactive shell.
rounds.change: Abort owned event listeners, stop animation and reconnection, close scene audio/socket work, and show the retry screen.
rounds.assessment: Inject context loss into a real initialized browser, reload deliberately, and retain normal graphics and network recovery. A supplementary delayed-timer probe invalidated the initially passing quick result; clear all UI/pending-seat timers and rerun the same probe.

rounds.hypothesis: A self-contained initial sky texture preserves a calm, readable scene when the panorama is unavailable.
rounds.change: Use an original canvas-gradient texture immediately, then replace its image on success and retain it on failure.
rounds.assessment: Run the same image-abort probe, inspect before/after screenshots, and verify normal rendering and downloadable capture. The rubric score stays flat; this adds bounded asset-failure robustness.

rounds.hypothesis: An owned single-command launcher removes the missing-backend trap and cleans up both development processes.
rounds.change: Launch both processes with explicit ports and signal cleanup; make the proxy follow REALTIME_PORT.
rounds.assessment: A real process/HTTP/WebSocket test verifies startup, proxying, and teardown. Source hashes now additionally cover scripts/tests/docs for reproducibility; the sealed browser evaluator and rubric are unchanged.

rounds.hypothesis: Serving the build and realtime from one bounded origin removes the deployment mismatch without exposing source files.
rounds.change: Add an explicit static build server, correct MIME/HEAD/cache semantics, a separate health endpoint, path validation, and loopback default.
rounds.assessment: A fixture-based real HTTP test checks assets, methods, traversal, source exclusion, caching, and health without depending on an existing build. Core browser journeys remain unchanged.

rounds.hypothesis: A same-origin browser guard prevents unrelated sites from silently joining the local room while keeping legitimate proxy and CLI clients working.
rounds.change: Validate browser origins against the received host or an explicit additional-origin list; retain origin-less protocol clients.
rounds.assessment: Real upgrade requests exercise allowed, unrelated, null, and explicitly configured origins; browser proxy journeys guard against accidental deployment rejection. This does not add authentication.

rounds.hypothesis: A bounded room with native ping/pong liveness can release abandoned participants and shut down predictably.
rounds.change: Bound capacity, terminate missing-pong sessions, and clean up the owned server on termination signals.
rounds.assessment: Protocol tests keep one healthy participant, drop a non-ponging participant, reject overflow, and admit a replacement; browser recovery and teardown remain intact.

rounds.hypothesis: Coalescing state broadcasts and bounding per-client input prevents burst amplification while retaining acknowledgements and final state.
rounds.change: Coalesce room state within 16 ms, serialize once per broadcast, cap application messages and outgoing buffered bytes.
rounds.assessment: The same bounded-burst probe must pass after previously failing; a separate real socket flood must close with policy code 1008. Ten-client seating and browser presence must remain intact. Score stays flat; bounded traffic is secondary evidence.

rounds.hypothesis: Pausing scene work and sound on visibility loss prevents background drawing and unexpected audio restart.
rounds.change: Pause drawing and active scene time while hidden, suspend audio without auto-resume, defer environment updates, and guard asynchronous audio feedback after teardown.
rounds.assessment: The same instrumented browser probe requires zero drawing while hidden, visible drawing recovery, suspended sound, and no automatic restart. This is visibility fault injection, not a real-phone battery measurement.

rounds.hypothesis: Explicitly disposing passenger-owned resources releases graphics buffers when real visitors depart without affecting remaining avatars.
rounds.change: Collect and dispose unique passenger geometry/materials/textures exactly once, including on graphics teardown.
rounds.assessment: A real browser intercepts native buffer deletion; an ownership test checks deduplicated and idempotent disposal while another passenger remains. This does not claim a measured RAM/VRAM quantity.
